## Welcome To api-sports

### We work hard every day

In order to provide you with a quality API, we are working every day on new features. Find the complete list of features on our documentation.

## COVERAGE

We cover **+1 200** leagues & cups with livescore, standings, events, line-ups, players, pre-matches odds, statistics..

## EASY INTEGRATION

We have built a simple and logical architecture to facilitate your developments

## CHAT SUPPORT

Our team is on hand to answer your questions directly on our dashboard :

[https://dashboard.api-football.com](https://dashboard.api-football.com/ "Support")

## HISTORICAL DATA

Several years of data available, ideal for statistics, fantasy football etc..

## PRE-MATCH & LIVE ODDS

Pre-match odds and live odds available in all our plans

## LIVESCORE

Real-time matches and events updated every 15 seconds. (In all our plans)

## QUESTIONS

### Frequently asked questions

Feel free to contact us directly by email or on social networks for any questions you may have about our API.

#### CUSTOM PLAN

You need more requests and/or a higher ratelimit per minute for a high traffic application or website. We have plan up to 1 500 000 requests per day.

#### IS MY PAYMENT INFORMATION SECURE?

Credit cards are processed through a PCI compliant banking partner.

#### WHAT IF I EXCEED MY PLAN LIMITS?

You’ll never be overcharged. once your quota is reached, the API automatically stops processing requests and sends an error message instead of billing extra

#### WHEN WILL I BE BILLED?

Your subscription is entirely under your control. Each plan is prepaid for the selected duration, with no auto-renewal or hidden charges. When it expires, your account automatically returns to the free plan.
